async def act(page):
    # Set the date filter for May 2023
    filter_row = page.get_by_role('row', name='Any . From: Date selector . To : Date selector . . . . . .')
    # Fill the 'From' date textbox (first textbox in the cell for 'From:')
    from_textbox = filter_row.get_by_role('cell', name='From: Date selector . To : Date selector .').get_by_role('textbox').first
    await from_textbox.fill('05/01/2023')
    # Fill the 'To' date textbox (second textbox in the same cell)
    to_textbox = filter_row.get_by_role('cell', name='From: Date selector . To : Date selector .').get_by_role('textbox').nth(1)
    await to_textbox.fill('05/31/2023')
    # Click the 'Search' button to apply the filter
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    # Wait for the page to update after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Locate the pagination row to get the total records count
    pagination_row = page.get_by_role('row', name='Page Go to Previous page 1 Go to Next page of 2 pages | View 20 per page| Total 24 records found |Pending Reviews RSS Reset Filter Search')
    total_text = await pagination_row.get_by_role('cell', name='Page Go to Previous page 1 Go to Next page of 2 pages | View 20 per page| Total 24 records found |Pending Reviews RSS').text_content()
    # Extract the number from the text (e.g., 'Total 24 records found')
    import re
    match = re.search(r'Total (\d+) records found', total_text)
    if match:
        total_count = match.group(1)
        # Return the total count as the result
        return total_count
    else:
        # If no match, return the raw text for debugging
        return total_text
